CustomField.description: This field will calculate the number of days an Opportunity is in the Offer Out Stage.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( Offer_In_Date__c ), NOW() - Offer_Out_Date__c , Offer_In_Date__c - Offer_Out_Date__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will calculate the number of days an Opportunity is in the Offer Out Stage.
CustomField.label: Days In Offer Out Stage
